items.title: Gaslamp Zombie Crawl — Friday Night
items.description: The Gaslamp Zombie Crawl kicks off Halloween weekend Friday. Participating bars have their wristband deals — one price gets you into multiple venues. The crawl officially runs 7pm-midnight but the Gaslamp stays zombie-occupied well past that. Zombie makeup encouraged, costumes required at most venues.
items.address: Fifth Ave and G St, San Diego, CA 92101

items.title: Gaslamp Zombie Crawl — Saturday Night
items.description: Saturday of the Gaslamp Zombie Crawl is the bigger night — more costumed participants and most of the Gaslamp bars go all-in. Wristband packages available at the starting point. Come ready; the makeup stations run out of product early.
items.address: Fifth Ave and G St, San Diego, CA 92101

items.title: Gaslamp Zombie Crawl — Friday Before Halloween
items.description: The final Friday of the Zombie Crawl is the last-chance night before Halloween itself. Most participating bars are still running the wristband program. Look for the wandering hordes on Fifth Ave starting around 8pm.
items.address: Fifth Ave and G St, San Diego, CA 92101

items.title: Gaslamp Halloween Night — Zombie Crawl Finale
items.description: Halloween itself — the Zombie Crawl finale. The Gaslamp becomes a pedestrian zoo of costumes by 8pm. Every bar has something going on. This is the one night where the street itself is the event as much as any venue. Expect slow movement on Fifth Ave after 9pm.
items.address: Fifth Ave and G St, San Diego, CA 92101
